entities.name: Phyresis
entities.description: The transformation of a living thing into a Phyrexian creature.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: A mutagen that twists minds and replaces vital liquids in the host, preparing it for compleation.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: A surgical process that swaps the body's organic matter with artificial machinery.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Beings who reproduce with flesh vats and birthing pods or by infection.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: An individual immune to phyresis who helped reverse Ajani and Nissa and died at great cost.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped reverse phyresis in Ajani Goldmane and Nissa Revane.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped reverse phyresis and was left sparkless.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A substance that can stave off glistening oil's effects.

entities.name: Lazotep
entities.description: A way of eliminating compleation by turning the Phyrexian organism into an eternal zombie.

events.summary: Teferi Akosa, Melira and Karn completely reversed phyresis in Ajani Goldmane and Nissa Revane, at the cost of Melira's death and Karn losing his spark.
events.quote: managed to completely reverse Ajani Goldmane and Nissa Revane
